fixes: rate_tiers now gives tier 1 the quantity from 0 up to and including its up_to and starts each later tier at the previous up_to.
standing_line prorates the standing charge over the days of the billing period instead of a hard-coded 30-day month.
energy_lines and standing_line round each exact line value half to even to 0.01 with decimal.Decimal and return it as a two-decimal string.
settle compares the subtotal with the commitment, returns the total as subtotal x (1 - credit_rate) rounded half to even and the credit as subtotal minus total.
Removed the separate consumption 'base' that rated reads which had been rejected.
validations: tier boundaries at, below and above each up_to of every rate_card plan
half-to-even rounding of line amounts, subtotals and totals
standing charge proration over 28, 29, 30, 31 and 62 day periods
credit applied exactly when the subtotal reaches the commitment
credit plus total equals the subtotal on every shipped invoice
visible unit tests of tariff.core behaviour
